title: National Telecommunications and Information Administration: Phase 56O Remediation Follow-Through
summary: GAO reports that NTIA implemented one of eleven prior priority recommendations and now has ten priorities across spectrum, IT and cybersecurity, and broadband programs. Phase 56O decision: Publish the exact portfolio movement without converting one implementation into an infrastructure-security or broadband-performance conclusion.
key_findings: Exact record: GAO-26-109042 NTIA priority recommendation portfolio.
Status period: July 2025 baseline through June 2026.
Continuation rule: Reopen when GAO publishes the next NTIA priority letter or a named current recommendation changes status.
why_it_matters: The record exposes implementation throughput and remaining remediation workload without converting a portfolio into a performance rate.
ftfn_relevance: Keeps implemented, added, de-prioritized, current, modeled, and realized states distinct.
Attaches source, period, scope, limitation, remaining gap, and continuation rule.
evidence_limits: The portfolio covers spectrum, IT and cybersecurity, and broadband programs. One implemented recommendation does not establish infrastructure security, broadband sustainability, or spectrum performance.
Action-level closure evidence for the ten priorities and operating measures for spectrum coordination, infrastructure security, and broadband-program sustainability.
No ranking, composite, readiness score, performance rate, or causal claim is supported.
